China cannot be the country that succeeds in ... They're a nation that is willing to control what takes place. It doesn't help their citizens, but it can help their efforts around the world. It should be America that establishes that case.

Artificial intelligence is scaling rapidly, and as a result, it is increasingly shaping how we learn, how we work, and how we prepare for the future. Today’s hearing examines AI and its growing role in education, workforce development, and the future of work.
statements.venue: Opening statement, House Education and Workforce Committee hearing 'Building an AI-Ready America'

statements.text: That said, AI growth is not without challenges. Models can make mistakes. In education, that raises concerns about academic integrity and overreliance. In the workforce, early evidence suggests AI may change how tasks are performed, particularly for entry-level roles, which underscores the need for strong pathways into the labor market and strong skills development.
statements.venue: Opening statement, House Education and Workforce Committee hearing 'Building an AI-Ready America'

statements.text: The goal should not be to rush into sweeping new rules and regulations, but to ensure schools, employers, and training providers can keep pace with innovation while maintaining trust and prioritizing safety and privacy. [...] U.S. leadership in AI is pivotal to the nation’s economic success and security.
statements.venue: Opening statement, House Education and Workforce Committee hearing 'Building an AI-Ready America'

Congratulations to the winners and all who participated!
statements.quoted: Thrilled to host K-12 student winners of @POTUS’ AI Challenge. Their ingenuity and passion for using AI to serve their communities were truly impressive. The future is bright. https://t.co/DpuYbx512k

statements.text:
As AI continues to reshape workplaces across our economy, we must have information about its impact.

Today, I introduced the AWARE Act to ensure we have the data necessary to support our workforce, strengthen training programs, and ensure that the U.S. remains at the forefront of technological innovation.
https://t.co/lsABhFCKdm

Artificial intelligence is rapidly transforming our workforce, make it essential for us to understand the impact this new technology is having on our employment landscape. [...] This legislation will provide the clarity necessary to support workers, guide training, and ensure the United States stays at the forefront of technological innovation.
statements.venue: WSJM news report on AWARE Act introduction

statements.text: Our current workforce data struggles to capture how AI is already changing the way work is being done. This is a concern we’ve heard from job creators, and workers feel that uncertainty as well.

AI should strengthen, not destabilize, our education and workforce systems, and many educators and employers are already showing how that can be done responsibly. [...] If we get this right, AI won’t just change the future — it will create more opportunity for more Americans.

Foreign adversaries, especially the People’s Republic of China, remain a threat to America. Their military-civil fusion strategy and national intelligence laws that require citizens and companies to assist the Chinese government intelligence efforts when requested create risks for American companies who may choose to partner with them in key fields such as humanoid robotics.
statements.venue: Letter to Commerce Secretary Lutnick on AGIBOT humanoid robots

statements.text: To get government fully involved with controlling it, setting up the standards will restrict it.
